voices.name: Rhea - Sad & Heartbroken Character
voices.description: Expressive, Emotional, Dramatic — Rhea cracks mid-sentence when a lover leaves over a text, sobs to her mother about a marriage that could not be saved, and goes numb reading his wedding card. Her Hindi female tone carries real ache, from shaky whispers to full tears, without overacting. Built for micro-dramas, audio series, breakup reels, web shows, short films and anime or game dubbing that needs genuine pain. Viewers feel the loss before the scene ends.

voices.name: Rhea - Animated & Angry Character
voices.description: Frustrated, Sassy, Condescending — Rhea slides from a sugar-sweet, tight-lipped smile into a biting, snapping tirade, every line aimed straight at the listener, her brittle edge making each scolding sting. Sketch-comedy reels, sitcom-style rants and difficult-client role-play all get a reaction on the first take, the reason comedy channels, BPO training teams, e-learning studios and service-desk coaches cast her for de-escalation drills and complaint-handling simulators.

voices.name: Rhea - Emotional Drama Actor
voices.description: Raw, restrained, and vulnerable, carrying grief in silence rather than in tears, letting the audience feel it first. Built for film dubbing, audio drama, dramatic monologues, character voicing, serialized fiction, video game cutscenes, and emotional scene narration. A strong fit for streaming platforms, audio drama studios, and dubbing houses, and for filmmakers and producers casting a genuinely affecting dramatic performer.

voices.name: Rhea - Social Media Narrator
voices.description: Neutral Indian-American accent, clear and easy to follow. Casual and natural, with the kind of pacing that keeps people watching. Made for social media narration and story-driven clips.

voices.name: Rhea - Natural & Real Angry Girl
voices.description: Sharp, convincing, and genuinely pissed off — Rhea moves through every shade of anger, from clipped irritation to full outburst, without ever sounding like pure shouting. Her natural delivery keeps each layer distinct and believable, staying grounded even at peak intensity. Built for character voiceover, game NPCs, dramatic scenes, and confrontation-heavy dialogue. Ideal for game studios, animation, and interactive fiction needing genuine anger.

voices.name: Rhea - Happy, Positive Character
voices.description: Bright, warm, and genuinely radiant — Rhea carries happiness the way it actually feels, finding real joy in small moments without needing to force the energy. Her expressive delivery moves naturally from quiet contentment to full excitement, staying convincing at every level. Built for character voiceover, game NPCs, animation, and upbeat storytelling. Ideal for game studios, kids content, and interactive fiction needing genuine happiness.

voices.name: Rhea - Bright & Expressive Customer Care
voices.description: Energetic, human-like, and naturally engaging — Rhea handles customer care and support scripts with genuine enthusiasm on repeat queries. Her lively, reactive delivery covers troubleshooting, complaints, and routine queries clearly. Built for customer support, helpdesk, call center, and voice agent applications. Ideal for banking, telecom, ecommerce, and service industry customer care teams requiring an energetic, conversational tone.

voices.name: Rhea - Bright & Expressive Customer Care
voices.description: Warm, reactive, and consistently natural — Rhea adjusts across customer support, helpdesk, and call center scripts, shifting tone for troubleshooting, reassurance, and routine queries without sounding scripted. Built for customer support, IVR, helpdesk, and voice agent applications spanning multiple emotional tones. Ideal for CX platforms and businesses that want support calls to sound human, not robotic.

voices.name: Rhea
voices.description: Calm and focused, alto female voice. Perfect for meditation, hypnosis & narration.

voices.name: Rhea - Soft, Calm & Reassuring
voices.description: Renita brings dynamic range and authentic presence to every project, seamlessly transitioning from warm, conversational narration to commanding commercial delivery. Her distinctive vocal texture and impeccable timing make her an ideal choice for brands, audiobooks, e-learning, and interactive media.

voices.name: Rhea - Comforting Companion
voices.description:
A warm, emotionally expressive voice that instantly makes listeners feel safe and understood.

Rhea’s conversational tone blends approachability with genuine care—ideal for scenarios where empathy and clarity are essential, yet the experience must feel human and comforting.

Perfect for mental wellness platforms like Wysa and InnerHour, AI therapist bots, support modules, self-help podcasts, and relationship guidance content on Spotify, YouTube, and Calm.

voices.name: Rhea Campbell - Strong and Confident
voices.description: A strong, confident CEO and businesswoman.
